description: Scripted multi-turn conversations (synthetic). After the last turn, the merged structured record must hold what the patient said and leave the rest empty: 'contains' means the field must include that text (case-insensitive), null means the field must stay empty, a bare string must match exactly, and an absent key isn't checked.
